lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Lost WinterNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56FOUR CASES, AND NOTHING TO CONNECT THEMYou take down the cards, and put them in a drawer, and say that you have been working too hard. In the spring a bank has a second clerk drowned, and an astronomer in Greenwich has a second study robbed, and a widow in Fife dies in her sleep. Nobody looks for a pattern. It is a good year for a mathematician who does not wish to be noticed. It will be four years before you hear his name, and by then there will be no way of undoing what has been done. You never forget the cards.
